architecture: Option C: NeLisp policy process behind native adapter

transport.endpoint: DDSKK_PIPE_NAME; default is reserved for live use
transport.mode: Windows duplex message pipe; one WriteFile equals one request
transport.oversized_message: ReadFile ERROR_MORE_DATA closes client; no partial dispatch
transport.request_encoding: UTF-8; trim trailing CR and LF only
transport.response: one message; no appended newline; public STATE uses 6-digit lowercase Unicode scalar hex
transport.zero_length_message: not a valid request; no success guarantee

public_requests.effect: engine stdio STATE2; adapter still emits public STATE

public_requests.response: OK ENGINE <id> | OK SWITCHING <id> | ERR ENGINE

public_requests.meaning: intent accepted; old child remains until replacement/fence

public_requests.response: RULES 1 <encoded ordered rules> | ERR RULES NOT-READY

public_requests.meaning: immutable built-in display only; does not alter session or evaluate expressions
SK1 asynchronous cache; wait=0; invalid local frame returns SERVER 4

public_requests.response: ACK <same id> <revision> | ERR LOCAL LEARN | ERR LOCAL STORAGE | ERR LOCAL <error symbol>
public_requests.meaning: idempotent operation; ACK waits for durable checkpoint barrier

public_requests.response: STATE ... | ERR SESSION LOST | editing error
public_requests.meaning: must explicitly OPEN 2; never implicitly revive a lost context
feed exact reading once, retain recovery checkpoint
prepare and convert; preserve automatic okuri conversion
keyless conversion from prepared authoritative state; never advance an automatic conversion twice
legacy delayed RESET cannot steal another composition
CONVERT also selects next candidate; PREVIOUS selects previous
host reset/replay; preexisting candidate or registration bypasses second CONVERT
UTF8 variants require negotiation where engine checks it; decimal replay retains exact order

public_requests.response: STATE ... | ERR REGISTER [symbol] | ERR REGISTRATION REQUEST

public_requests.meaning: registration editor feed; outside registration unsupported
framework runner transparent relay; feature depends on selected engine

public_requests.response: OK COMPACT | OK COMPACT NOOP | ERR COMPACT <symbol>

public_requests.meaning: host shutdown intent; child/job and durability drain follow

public_requests.response: ERR REQUEST | ERR SESSION | ERR LOCAL | operation-specific error; child decode failure disconnects

engine_stdio.startup: WIRE UTF8 1 then WIRE LEARNING 2; skip PHASE lines. Exact OK selects new mode; old ERR REQUEST retains legacy writer and STATE relay
engine_stdio.STATE: STATE mode cursor composition-start text-hex pending-hex candidate-index comma-candidate-hex [registration-reading-hex]; empty field is -
engine_stdio.STATE2: STATE2 mode cursor start index count registration-flag LF; scalar-count:UTF8 fields for text,pending,each candidate,optional registration reading; final LF
engine_stdio.STATE2_utf8: strict scalars; reject overlong, surrogate, bad continuation, >U+10FFFF; public translation is scalar hex
engine_stdio.LEARNING2: LEARNING2 scalar-count LF; UTF8 content followed by LF; scalar-count <=1048576; native decoder reads continuation bytes per scalar

intermediates.SERVER: host resolves built-ins then SK1 worker; <=200ms cache wait; metadata unlocked, interpreter ownership retained
intermediates.LOCAL-PUBLISH: native publication barrier; LOCAL-PUBLISHED or ERR LOCAL STORAGE returned to engine
intermediates.LEARNING2: captured FIFO/outbox before returning terminal STATE or ACK

session_lifecycle.eviction: least recently used; explicit V2 request after eviction returns ERR SESSION LOST
session_lifecycle.restart: volatile contexts lost; OPEN then restore known reading. Never blindly retry arbitrary non-idempotent edit
session_lifecycle.disconnect: close sessions still owned by disconnecting client; last owner wins when ID reused
session_lifecycle.legacy: one active input client; new KEY/CONTROL resets before takeover; delayed foreign RESET acknowledged without publication
session_lifecycle.state_mirror: accepted STATE publishes scoped numeric PID where applicable; local owner precedence; named map is volatile, not recovery authority

local_index.payload: sorted unique UTF8 keys; contiguous key/user/shared strings; SKK slash candidate encoding; rules last
local_index.checksum: SHA256 of entire file with checksum field zeroed
local_index.base: generation-*.index immutable compiled sources; ordered candidates; unsupported sentinel requires provider
local_index.overlay: overlay-*.index user rows; metadata BASE generation-*.index; same configuration digest; capabilities <=7
local_index.current: exact ASCII index basename, NO newline; <=100 bytes; generation-/overlay- prefix, .index suffix, lowercase a-z0-9-. only
local_index.publication: flush index then validate, flush temporary manifest, MoveFileEx REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH current; retain old reader leases
local_index.security: owner/SYSTEM protected DACL; reject reparse; read handles deny delete; cleanup only unleased generations

spool.name: pending-<pid>-<32hex client>.queue
spool.row: <client.operation> <key scalar hex> <candidate scalar hex> <sequence decimal> <okuri hex or -> LF
spool.lease: exclusive .queue.lock; dead producer ownership transferred after durable target spool write; queue limit 256
spool.durability: flush temp then atomic replacement; retain until exact durable ACK; malformed/torn records not acknowledged

provider_outbox.name: <jisyo>.eg2-outbox
provider_outbox.record: EG2-OUTBOX 1 <id> <UTF8 byte length> <FNV1a64 decimal> LF + content + LF + EG2-END <id> LF
provider_outbox.content: nonempty <=8MiB; ends with ;; EG2 provider <id> LF
provider_outbox.durability: append+FlushFileBuffers before learning-bearing STATE; checkpoint then cursor flush+replace before truncation; incomplete unacknowledged tail discarded; corrupt complete record refuses recovery

learning_checkpoint.delta: ;; EG2 delta v2 LF followed by complete row replacements and metadata
learning_checkpoint.checkpoint: ;; EG2 checkpoint v2 LF; UTF8 coding marker, ;; EG2 revision <n>, optional ;; EG2 provider <n>, operation watermarks, jisyo rows
learning_checkpoint.stage: journal signature + snapshot + ;; EG2 length <prior bytes> LF; recover/reflush complete stages before retirement
learning_checkpoint.ordering: one FIFO worker; reserve/seal producers; candidate revision and durable watermark separate; storage refusal is ERR LOCAL STORAGE

configuration.cli: host executable [runtime executable] [repository]; engine runner chosen from engine ID and DDSKK_NELISP_ENTRY
configuration.precedence: explicit inherited env beats registry bridge; imported registry values refreshed on reload; UserJisyoPath expands environment strings
configuration.inventory: source-inventory-v1.json lists every literal environment/registry input with file:line and source hashes
configuration.private_test_hooks: DDSKK_HARNESS_DIAGNOSTICS and Software\NativeIME-test-* gate existing NATIVEIME_TEST_LOCAL_CONVERSION, publication stall and learning hold hooks
configuration.ownership: single host per pipe mutex; loser exits 0; host owns children in kill-on-close job; exactly one interpreter transaction and storage/publication writer; no callback enters engine or policy

allowed: index header.generation and generation/PID in BASE/current basenames
normalization.timestamps: not currently in transcript replies; never remove incidental numbers
normalization.generation_ids: disk replay validates original checksum first, zeroes header.generation, uses generation-0-0.index BASE and overlay-0-0.index current, adjusts derived bytes/rules_bytes and recomputes checksum; config SHA256 retained; no broad numeric substitution

coverage_boundary: native-v1.json covers representative public replies, eviction and replay; native-legacy-v1.json captures actual framework/lattice old-engine negotiation; native-disk-v1.json captures eight native files including a nonempty sealed provider outbox. No fixture can certify every input/error/crash branch. Core spool bytes require the registry/TSF lane; format and caller anchors are frozen here. Existing UTF8, learning, real-restart, SK1 and TSF/Emacs suites remain mandatory.
